books.title: Eyewitness to the Japanese Internment
books.author: Jill Roesler
books.about: Narrative nonfiction about daily life in the camps, including work, family life, and standing up to prejudice.
books.cite: Roesler, Jill. Eyewitness to the Japanese Internment. Child's World.

books.title: The Japanese Internment Camps: A History Perspectives Book
books.author: Rachel A. Bailey
books.about: Tells the facts of the World War II camps and shows the event from different people's points of view.
books.cite: Bailey, Rachel A. The Japanese Internment Camps: A History Perspectives Book. Cherry Lake Publishing.

books.title: Write to Me: Letters from Japanese American Children to the Librarian They Left Behind
books.author: Cynthia Grady
books.about: A true story about a San Diego librarian who wrote letters and sent books to Japanese American children in the camps.
books.cite: Grady, Cynthia. Write to Me: Letters from Japanese American Children to the Librarian They Left Behind. Charlesbridge.
